The short answer: Laifen’s newest models are its best. The Laifen Air at about C$100 is the pick for most people, the Air Diffuser at about C$100 has the highest rating in the range at 4.6 stars, and the SE2 at about C$145 is the one to buy if your hair is thick or long. The one to avoid is the Laifen Swift gen 1 at about C$150 — despite costing more, it has the lowest rating in the range at 4.1 stars and its sales are falling. Laifen’s weakness as a brand is not quality; it is that its newest listings have only been on sale for four to eleven months, so its long-term reliability is genuinely unproven.

Laifen hair dryer models compared

Laifen sells six hair dryers on Amazon.ca, and they are not interchangeable. The range spans about C$100 to about C$220, ratings from 4.1 to 4.6 stars, and wildly different sales trajectories — the newest models are growing while the oldest is declining.

What we checked for every model:

  • CAD price and current Amazon.ca rating with rating count
  • Estimated monthly unit sales, and whether that figure is rising or falling
  • Category BSR and how long the listing has been live
  • Who holds the Buy Box, because it determines who honours your warranty
  • Whether the listing is brand-operated, which matters in a category where grey-market resellers are common

How to read the labels in this guide. Review analysis means a pattern across all 8,261 Canadian reviews in our dataset. Amazon.ca data is verifiable by you today. Buyer feedback is a single quoted experience. Manufacturer claim is unverified.

One honest caveat. Our review sample averages 3.37 stars while these products display 4.1–4.6 stars on Amazon.ca. We use it for theme and pain-point analysis only, never as a substitute for a product’s displayed rating.

Where Laifen sits in the Canadian market. Across the Amazon.ca Hair Dryers top 50, Laifen accounts for 5.9% of unit sales but 13.4% of revenue — it sells fewer dryers than the budget leaders and makes more money per unit, because its average selling price is about C$125 against a category median of about C$49 Amazon.ca data.

1. Laifen Air — the best Laifen for most people

about C$100 · 4.5★ (278 ratings) · about 534 units/month · BSR #25 · 4 months on sale · Buy Box: Laifen Official

The Air is Laifen’s newest model and already its highest-volume one, moving roughly 534 units a month. It reached BSR #25 within about four months of launch, which is fast for a category dominated by products that have been on sale for years.

What we liked

  • The highest unit volume in the Laifen range, which tells you Canadian buyers are finding it Amazon.ca data
  • Ionic frizz control has consistent positive buyer feedback rather than being a listing-only claim Review analysis
  • Brand-operated listing with a single seller — one counterparty for warranty claims Amazon.ca data
  • Sits in the price band where our data shows a 9.6% complaint rate, against 30.3% under C$50 Review analysis

What we didn’t

  • Only 4 months on sale, so there is very little long-term Canadian ownership data Amazon.ca data
  • Not dual voltage, so it is not a travel dryer Manufacturer claim
  • Replacement attachments are harder to source in Canada than for legacy brands Review analysis

Skip if: you travel internationally and need universal voltage — see our travel hair dryer guide — or you want a diffuser included as standard.

Check price at Amazon.ca

about C$110 · 4.5★ (550 ratings) · about 448 units/month · BSR #7 · 13 months on sale · Buy Box: Laifen Official

What we liked

  • 550 ratings — the largest review base of any Laifen model in Canada, which makes it the most informative Laifen to judge from Amazon.ca data
  • BSR #7, the highest category ranking in the entire Laifen range Amazon.ca data
  • Ships with a diffuser, which matters for curly and wavy hair Manufacturer claim

What we didn’t

Skip if: you want the best rating in the range, or you want the strongest current sales momentum.

3. Laifen Air Diffuser — the best-rated Laifen, and the one for curly hair

about C$100 · 4.6★ (379 ratings) · about 377 units/month · BSR #16 · 4 months on sale · Buy Box: Laifen Official

What we liked

  • 4.6★ — the highest rating in the entire Laifen range, from 379 Canadian buyers Amazon.ca data
  • A diffuser is built into the product rather than sold as a variant, which matters if you have curly or wavy hair Manufacturer claim
  • Positioned as a travel-capable ionic dryer, though not dual voltage Manufacturer claim
  • Young listing at 4 months with sales already at roughly 377 units a month Amazon.ca data

What we didn’t

  • Only 4 months on sale, so reliability data is thin Amazon.ca data
  • Attachment security is the thing to check. Our dataset contains 186 mentions of attachments falling off, 57% of them negative Review analysis
  • Not dual voltage despite travel-oriented marketing Manufacturer claim

Skip if: you air-dry or use a diffuser rarely — you would be paying for an attachment you do not need. If you do have curly or wavy hair, see our curly hair dryer guide.

4. Laifen SE2 — the best Laifen for thick or long hair

about C$145 · 4.5★ (189 ratings) · about 319 units/month · BSR #17 · 11 months on sale · Buy Box: Laifen Official

The SE2 has the strongest growth signal in the Laifen range at roughly +89% month over month, and it is the model aimed at exactly the buyer who returns a dryer for being underpowered.

What we liked

  • The highest month-over-month growth of any Laifen model, by a wide margin Amazon.ca data
  • Built for thick or long hair, where airflow is the deciding specification Manufacturer claim
  • Diffuser included Manufacturer claim
  • Two sellers, but Buy Box held by Laifen Official — the warranty counterparty is still the brand Amazon.ca data

What we didn’t

  • At C$145 it is close to entry Dyson territory, which weakens the value argument versus the Air Amazon.ca data
  • Heavier than the Air, and reviewers of step-up dryers across the category consistently flag the extra weight Review analysis
  • Only 189 ratings, so the sample is still modest Amazon.ca data

Skip if: your hair is fine — you would be paying for power you do not need.

Check price at Amazon.ca

5. Laifen Swift (gen 1) — the Laifen to avoid

about C$150 · 4.1★ (442 ratings) · about 113 units/month · BSR #39 · 23 months on sale · Buy Box: Laifen Official

We do not recommend this model, and it is worth explaining why in detail — because it is the most expensive-looking trap in the Laifen range and it is easy to buy by mistake.

What we liked

  • The longest Canadian track record in the range at 23 months Amazon.ca data
  • 442 ratings, so there is real evidence to judge from Amazon.ca data

What we didn’t

  • 4.1★ — the lowest rating in the entire Laifen range, against 4.5–4.6★ for every newer model Amazon.ca data
  • Sales are declining at roughly -39% month over month, while the newer models are flat or growing strongly Amazon.ca data
  • The most expensive non-diffuser Laifen at about C$150 — you pay more for the weakest-rated model Amazon.ca data
  • The two-year-old platform has been superseded; Laifen’s newer models reflect two more years of development Amazon.ca data

Skip if: you are considering it at all. Buy the SE2 at about C$145 instead — it is cheaper, rated 4.5★, and growing.

Is Laifen a reliable brand?

Unproven, not unreliable — and that distinction matters. Laifen’s newest Canadian listings have been on sale for four to eleven months. There is not yet enough long-term ownership data to say how a Laifen behaves in year three.

What we can say from 8,261 Canadian reviews:

MetricValue
Median reported failure across the category5.5 months
Reviews naming a specific failure month552
Failed out of the box0.8%
Durability mentions that were negative84%

Where Laifen sits by price band. At about C$100 to about C$220, every Laifen model except the Air and Air Diffuser falls in the over-C$120 band, and those two sit just below it. That band had a 9.6% complaint rate across 334 reviews, against 30.3% for dryers under C$50 across 3,259 reviews Review analysis.

The structural advantage Laifen does have. Every one of the six models sells through a brand-operated Amazon.ca listing with the Buy Box held by Laifen Official. Warranty and service complaints were the second-largest complaint cluster in our dataset at 610 negative mentions and an 81% negative share, and a large part of that problem is reseller listings where nobody owns the claim. Laifen does not have that problem Amazon.ca data.

What we will publish. Once units complete our protocol we will publish measured noise, weight and dry times on the Lab Test Card. We will also publish long-term tracking, because “does it survive year two” is the question our data says buyers care about most and nobody currently answers. Our method is published on how we test, and the full durability dataset is in how long hair dryers actually last.

Three things to verify before buying any Laifen:

  1. The ALCI plug — a rectangular GFCI-style box on the plug end. One Canadian reviewer flagged a dryer on Amazon.ca as non-compliant and recalled for missing it
  2. Which model you are actually buying. Laifen names overlap confusingly: “Swift” covers two models with a 4.1★ and a 4.5★ rating, and “Air” covers two more. Check the ASIN, not the name
  3. Price history — these models discount regularly, so check before paying list price

Laifen hair dryer FAQ

Which Laifen hair dryer is best? The Laifen Air at about C$100 is the best for most people, and the Laifen SE2 at about C$145 is the best if your hair is thick or long. The Laifen Air Diffuser has the highest rating of the range at 4.6 stars and is the strongest pick for curly hair.

Which Laifen model should I avoid? The Laifen Swift gen 1 at about C$150. It carries the lowest rating in the range at 4.1 stars, and its sales are declining at roughly −39% month over month while every newer Laifen model is growing or flat. It is also the oldest listing at 703 days.

Is Laifen a reliable brand? Unproven rather than unreliable. Laifen’s newest Canadian listings have been on sale for only 4 to 11 months, so there is not yet enough long-term data to judge reliability. What we can say is that all six models sit in the price band where our data shows complaint rates of 9.6%, against 30.3% under C$50.

Are Laifen hair dryers sold by the brand in Canada? Yes. All six models sell through brand-operated Amazon.ca listings with one or two sellers, and the Buy Box is held by Laifen Official on every one. That gives you a single counterparty for a warranty claim, which is more than can be said for several competitors in this category.

How much does a Laifen hair dryer cost in Canada? Prices run from about C$100 for the Air and Air Diffuser, through about C$110 for the SE Lite and about C$145 for the SE2, up to about C$150 for the Swift gen 1 and about C$220 for the Swift with diffuser. The effective sweet spot is about C$100 to about C$145.

Does Laifen work outside Canada? No. None of the six Laifen models sold on Amazon.ca is marketed as dual voltage, so they are 120V-only and not suitable for Europe, the UK or Australia without a voltage converter. If you travel, look at the Dreame Pocket Pro instead.

Is Laifen a good Dyson alternative? It is the closest thing to one on price, at roughly a quarter of Supersonic pricing for the same high-airflow, lower-heat approach. Dyson remains ahead on proven reliability, Canadian service network and universal voltage. Our full breakdown is in the Laifen vs Dyson comparison.

Our verdict on the Laifen hair dryer range

Buy the Laifen Air at about C$100, or the Air Diffuser at the same price if you have curly hair. For thick or long hair, the SE2 at about C$145 is worth the step up — it has the strongest sales momentum in the range at roughly +89% month over month.

Avoid the Swift gen 1 at about C$150. It costs more than the SE2, rates lower at 4.1★ against 4.5★, and is the only Laifen model in decline at roughly −39%. Check the ASIN before ordering, because the model names overlap badly.

And treat the brand’s reliability as unproven rather than proven. Every Laifen model sells through a brand-operated Canadian listing, which is a genuine structural advantage for warranty claims. But the newest listings are only four months old, and our category data shows a median reported failure time of 5.5 months across 8,261 reviews. Buy the warranty terms you are comfortable with, check the ALCI plug on arrival, and keep the receipt. For how Laifen compares against the brand it undercuts, see Laifen vs Dyson, and for the wider shortlist see our best hair dryers guide.
